persona.name: Alex Rivera
persona.goal: Find a reliable and affordable invoicing software

scenario: Alex needs to switch from manual spreadsheets to an automated invoicing tool to save time.

user_actions: Realizes manual invoicing takes too much time
Searches Google for 'best small business invoicing tools'
stages.thoughts: There are too many options. Which one is actually simple to use?
opportunities: Publish a clear, interactive feature and pricing comparison guide

user_actions: Signs up for a free 14-day trial
stages.thoughts: I hope setting up my first invoice doesn't take longer than 10 minutes.
pain_points: Blank dashboard upon first login without a quick-start template
opportunities: Add a 1-minute interactive setup wizard upon sign-up

user_actions: Enters credit card details for the monthly plan
Generates and sends the first client invoice
stages.thoughts: That was fast and painless. Let's see how clients react to the link.
opportunities: Send a transparent receipt and a one-click calendar reminder before trial ends

user_actions: Receives first online payment from a client
Contacts live chat with a tax-formatting question
stages.thoughts: Support answered in 2 minutes. This is worth the monthly subscription.
pain_points: Difficulty finding local tax settings documentation
opportunities: Proactively surface regional tax setup tooltips in the settings panel
